title_en: Korean Vowels Began With a Single Dot #Shorts
desc_en:
In 1446, Hangul's vowels were built from three shapes: a dot for the sky, a flat line for the earth, and a standing line for people.
In 1933 the dot was dropped from the alphabet. Today it is back as a key on the phone keypad.

Full film: Twenty-Eight Letters — https://youtu.be/WXl74zoyXVg
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #hangul #korean
desc_ko:
1446년, 한글 모음은 세 모양으로 만들어졌습니다. 하늘을 본뜬 점, 땅을 본뜬 평평한 선, 사람을 본뜬 선 선.
1933년 점은 자모에서 빠졌고, 지금은 휴대폰 자판의 키로 돌아왔습니다.
